_comment: TEMPLATE — copy to phase.json and fill in. Periodisation state. Rewritten by the logger only on a phase transition, new microcycle, or changed constraint (a /review trigger). Mesocycle ~3-6 weeks; recovery microcycle every ~3-4 weeks of loading.
macrocycle: <the season-level context, e.g. off-season, no fixed target meet yet>
current_phase: <base | build | peak | recover, with an optional descriptor>
microcycle_note: <a few sentences on what this block is doing and why, and what the next block should do>
active_constraints: Finish every block on the start wall (block totals are multiples of two pool lengths).
primary_focus: <the main adaptation this phase is chasing>
secondary_focus: <what to maintain alongside the primary focus>
transition_trigger: <the explicit, measurable condition that must be met to advance to the next phase>
